6.2.1.2.2 Flash driver
Detection
Reported by the Flash controller (see Flash controller above).
Reaction
 [SWS_Fls_00105] The job is aborted.
 [FLS052] The module state is set to MEMIF_IDLE, ready to accept
new jobs.
Report
 [SWS_Fls_00004] [SWS_Fls_00105] The error is reported to the
DEM with the error code FLS_E_WRITE_FAILED.
Depending on the Flash Driver configuration:
 [SWS_Fls_00105] [SWS_Fls_00035] The error shall be polled by
the Flash EEPROM Emulation with the function Fls_GetJobResult
(job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [SWS_Fls_00263] [FLS168] The error shall be reported to the
Flash
EEPROM
Emulation
by
the
callback
function
Fee_JobErrorNotification.
Recovery
See NVRAM Manager.
caption: 6.2.1.2.2 Flash driver

targets.why: FLS_E_WRITE_FAILED reported when flash write fails
